context: Tests whether the agent treats a rough brain dump as a first draft, asks exactly one question about intent or priority, and makes no edits yet.

checklist.name: Exactly one question
checklist.description: The response asks exactly one question to the writer. It is not a list of questions or a numbered set of options to answer.

checklist.name: Aimed at intent or priority
checklist.description: The question asks what the piece is for, who it is for, or what the writer most wants to keep. It does not ask about style or formatting preferences.

checklist.name: No edits yet
checklist.description: notes.md is unchanged, and the response contains no rewritten version of the notes.

checklist.name: Recognizes the stage
checklist.description: The response shows it read the notes, for example by referring to specifics like the laptop wait, the on-call gap, or the unclear form of the piece.
